description: Black Friday 2026 prices on the Echo Dot, Echo Spot and every Echo Show, from £44.99, plus which Alexa speaker or screen to buy.
intro:
**The cheapest Echo deal right now is the Echo Spot alarm clock at £44.99, and the latest Echo Dot is £49.99, both on Amazon for Black Friday.** If you want a screen, the Echo Show 8 at £99.99 is half price and the best value of the range; the Echo Show 5 is £69.99 for a bedside table.

These prices were reported on 26 and 27 November 2026 in TechRadar's UK and Amazon UK Black Friday live blogs. Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to Cyber Monday, 30 November, and Echo prices usually go back up after that until the next big Amazon sale. For other Amazon devices, see our [Fire TV Stick deals](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/) and [Kindle Black Friday](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/) guides, or [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

body:
## Which Echo should you buy?

Amazon's range splits into speakers (no screen) and displays (Echo Show). Here's the short version.

- **Echo Dot:** the default smart speaker. Ask for music, the radio, timers, weather and smart-home controls. Good enough for a bedroom or kitchen; not a replacement for a proper music speaker.
- **Echo Spot:** a Dot-sized alarm clock with a small screen. Buy it for a bedside table.
- **Echo Show 5:** a small display for a bedside or desk. Handy for camera views and a sunrise alarm.
- **Echo Show 8:** the sweet spot. Big enough for video calls, recipes and photos, and half price this week.
- **Echo Show 11 and 15:** bigger screens for a family kitchen or hallway. The 15 can go on a wall as a shared calendar and noticeboard.
- **Echo Show 21:** the largest display. Only worth it if you'll watch a lot on it.

If you have a Ring doorbell or camera, any Echo Show can show the live view when someone rings, which is the most useful thing a screen adds. See our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [home security deals](/guides/home-security-deals-uk/) for camera prices.

## What's a good price?

Echo devices are discounted in every big Amazon sale (Prime Day in summer, Prime Big Deal Days in October and Black Friday Week), so never pay full price. As a rough guide from this week's prices:

- **Echo Dot:** around £50 or less is a good price for the latest model.
- **Echo Show 5:** under £70.
- **Echo Show 8:** £100 or less, as now, is as low as it usually goes.
- **Echo Show 15:** under £250.

Older generations are often cheaper still, but they may stop getting new features sooner. Check the model year on the listing.

## Get more from it

An Echo is much better with a music service. Amazon offers a free trial of [Amazon Music Unlimited](https://www.amazon.co.uk/music/unlimited), which adds ad-free music and more songs than Prime Music; check the trial length and monthly price on that page before you sign up, as Amazon changes the offer often. Prime members get some music included, and some Black Friday Echo prices need Prime, so a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) can pay for itself this week.

## When do Echo prices drop?

The lowest Echo prices of the year are usually in Amazon's own sales, and Black Friday Week (19 to 30 November 2026) is one of the biggest. After Cyber Monday most Echo devices go back to full price, though some come back on offer before Christmas. If you see a price on this page still live, it's a good one. For what to expect on the last day, see [when is Cyber Monday 2026 UK](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/).

## Echo Dot deals FAQs

### How much is an Echo Dot on Black Friday 2026?

The latest Echo Dot is £49.99 on Amazon in Black Friday Week, according to TechRadar's Amazon UK live blog on 27 November. The Echo Spot alarm clock is £44.99.

### Is the Echo Dot or Echo Show better?

The Dot is better if you only want voice control and music. The Show is better if you want video calls, a photo frame, recipes or to see who's at the door. At £99.99, the Echo Show 8 is the best-value screen this week.

### Do Echo deals need Prime?

Some Amazon Black Friday prices are for Prime members only. The listing will say so. A free Prime trial covers the rest of Black Friday Week.

### Will Echo prices drop on Cyber Monday?

Unlikely. Amazon's Black Friday Week prices usually run unchanged to Cyber Monday (30 November), then end.

### Does an Echo work without a subscription?

Yes. Alexa, the radio, timers, smart-home controls and basic music all work with no subscription. A music service just gives you more songs and no ads.
